text: Testing plays an important role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of the code, like individual functions, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts work together. Many developers use test-driven development, which means they write tests before writing the actual code. Although this takes more time at the beginning, it helps find problems early. Good tests give developers confidence. When they make changes or add new features, they know their tests will catch mistakes. This confidence allows teams to improve software faster and with less fear of breaking things.
